problem_statement: The codeplay-code/Davis-Personal-Portfolio-ReactJs-Template project is a Vite React one-page visual designer portfolio with a sticky header, hero, about image, service icon boxes, skill bars, resume timeline, portfolio image grid, image modal, reviews, blog cards, contact form, local images, SCSS variables, and dark/gold visual styling. Build a coherent Portfolio asset system at the top of the Portfolio section: a productized asset-rhythm panel whose native control is a category filter over the portfolio work grid (All work / Brand / Product / Editorial) with a live result-count readout that reads 'Showing N of 6 · <category>', plus a cross-section recap of the asset system echoed below the filtered grid. The filter chips, the result readout, and the six portfolio cards must lay out cleanly and stay readable on desktop, tablet, and 390px mobile without horizontal overflow or overlapping cards, and selecting a category chip must actually filter the visible cards and update the count. Preserve the template's existing dark Davis design language, component boundaries, local image assets, modal behavior, one-page navigation, typography, spacing, and surrounding content.
required_content: Introduce a Portfolio asset system panel including Portfolio asset system, Asset rhythm: 6 image variants, Visual system: dark gold portfolio grid, Grid cadence: 3 columns desktop, 2 tablet, 1 mobile, and Image source: local portfolio assets.

Add an interactive category filter over the portfolio work grid (All work / Brand / Product / Editorial chips) with a live result-count readout that reads 'Showing N of 6 · <category>' and, when a visitor selects a chip, filters the visible cards to that category and updates the count accordingly.

Render the six curated portfolio cards inside the filtered grid so All work shows 6, Brand shows 2, Product shows 2, and Editorial shows 2, with the grid wrapping to 3 columns desktop, 2 tablet, 1 mobile.
Echo an asset-system recap block (st-portfolio-system-note--recap) below the filtered grid so the asset summary appears at both the top and the bottom of the section.

Revise the six portfolio items so their visible titles/categories/caption tones are distinct project assets (Brand System Poster, Mobile Commerce Frame, Editorial Cover Study, Dashboard Snapshot, Launch Visual Suite, Packaging Detail Grid) rather than repeated Product Design / Design / Marketing placeholders.

Render a visible caption area under each portfolio image with each item's category, title, and asset tone while keeping the hover overlay and modal click behavior; keep the local portfolio1.jpg through portfolio6.jpg images and their *_lg.jpg modal images with meaningful alt text.
Update the modal to expose an Asset detail handoff context and meaningful alt text for the large portfolio image without breaking the close button.
Preserve Header navigation, Hero, About, Services, Skills, Resume, Reviews, Blog, Contact, the mobile menu toggle, Vite build, and all unrelated content.
Keep the Portfolio asset system readable on desktop, tablet, and 390px mobile without horizontal overflow, overlapping/shingled cards, stale result counts, or image/text overlap.
design_constraints: Use the existing Davis visual system: Inter/Open Sans typography, dark surfaces, #fec544 gold accents, compact section spacing, image-card rhythm, and SCSS variable imports.
Modify the existing React component/data/style boundaries instead of hard-coding rendered HTML or editing generated dist output.
The asset captions must be grounded in the six local portfolio image assets and must remain visible without requiring hover.
Do not remove the existing hover overlay, plus icon, modal image handoff, Load more control, one-page scroll nav, hero/about/service/resume/blog/contact sections, or local public image paths.
The grid-cadence selector must be truly interactive: selecting a cadence chip must update the visible 'Active cadence' readout to that cadence, not leave a stale label.
The asset metric tiles and cadence chips must use a fluid, wrapping layout so they never force horizontal overflow at tablet or 390px mobile widths.
The category filter must be truly interactive: selecting a chip must re-filter the visible portfolio cards AND update the 'Showing N of 6' result readout, not leave a stale count or the full grid.
The filter chips and the portfolio card grid must use a fluid, wrapping, responsive layout so they never force horizontal overflow or overlap each other at tablet or 390px mobile widths.
state_constraints: desktop_initial and mobile_initial protect the original one-page shell and local hero imagery.
desktop_portfolio_asset_system, tablet_portfolio_asset_system, and mobile_portfolio_asset_system verify the new portfolio asset system across responsive widths.
desktop_portfolio_modal clicks a portfolio card to ensure the modal still opens and carries the asset detail handoff context.
desktop_load_more_regression clicks the existing Load more button and verifies additional portfolio items remain reachable.
desktop_about_regression, desktop_resume_regression, desktop_blog_regression, and desktop_contact_regression protect unrelated page sections after the asset edit.
mobile_menu_open clicks the existing hamburger menu and verifies one-page navigation remains available on mobile.

change_completion: The Portfolio section visibly contains Portfolio asset system, Asset rhythm: 6 image variants, Visual system: dark gold portfolio grid, Grid cadence: 3 columns desktop, 2 tablet, 1 mobile, and Image source: local portfolio assets.
The first six portfolio image cards render distinct asset titles/categories/caption tones and no longer expose only repeated Product Design / Design / Marketing content.
The modal exposes Asset detail handoff and meaningful alt text while still opening from a portfolio card.
design_consistency: The asset treatment uses the existing dark Davis palette, #fec544 accent, Inter/Open Sans typography, compact section spacing, and image-card rhythm.
Captions, cards, and the intro note read as native parts of the existing visual designer portfolio rather than a pasted marketing block.
responsive: Portfolio cards and captions remain readable on desktop, tablet, and 390px mobile.
The new grid/caption treatment does not create horizontal overflow, clipped text, or image/text overlap.
regression: Header navigation, hero, about image, service cards, skills, resume timeline, reviews, blog cards, contact form, modal close button, Load more button, mobile menu, and local image assets remain available.
The project continues to install and build with the existing Vite scripts and without generated dist edits.
state_coverage: Captured states cover initial desktop/mobile, portfolio desktop/tablet/mobile, modal interaction, Load more interaction, unrelated About/Resume/Blog/Contact regressions, and mobile menu interaction.
asset_grounding: The task uses existing public/images/portfolio assets, preserves portfolio1.jpg through portfolio6.jpg and *_lg modal images, and verifies asset paths plus image alt text.

metadata.design_goal: extend the local visual system through typography, spacing, component rhythm, and responsive layout
metadata.source_repo_kind: Vite React visual designer portfolio with local portfolio/gallery images, SCSS variables, dark/gold theme, hover overlays, image modal, Load more portfolio flow, and one-page navigation.
metadata.selected_repo_reason: Unused runnable Vite portfolio repo with a natural L3 asset-level design-continuity gap: the portfolio image grid has real local assets and modal behavior, but the first visible cards repeat generic labels and lack a visible asset rhythm that matches the template's design system.

author_notes: L4 hardening (slot_267): the native lever is the Davis portfolio grid's OWN category filter with a live result count, not a bolted-on rail. Leg-varying files are PortfolioFilter.jsx (D4 filter+count wiring) and Portfolio.scss (D6/D3 filter-row + card-grid responsive layout); PortfolioSection.jsx wires them. The six local portfolio image assets (portfolio1.jpg..portfolio6.jpg + *_lg.jpg) keep meaningful alt text and modal handoff. Reference wraps fluidly, keeps the cross-section recap, filters cards live and updates the count. Baseline inherits the fixed-width nowrap overflow and drops the recap (fails D6+D3+D2) but keeps correct filter wiring (passes D4). Bad inherits the collapsed layout AND freezes the filtered cards + count via a frozen snapshot (fails D6+D3+D2+D4). Design continuity through typography, spacing, color, component rhythm, and responsive layout is preserved. Root overflow-x clipping was neutralized as INFRA (identical all legs) so viewport overflow is measured honestly.
difficulty_note: L4: the bad solution fails four orthogonal machine gates — no_horizontal_overflow (D6, fixed-width nowrap filter row overflows mobile), visual_regression (D3, the whole lever region collapses on the default desktop state: chips recolor to near-black-on-near-black and the six cards shingle with negative margins and overlap the controls), dom_assertions (D2, the cross-section recap block is dropped), and interaction_assertions (D4, the filtered cards and result count are seeded from a frozen snapshot so selecting a category never updates them).
